# Adam Smith

> CTO and co-founder of Larx. Former US Army Special Forces (Green Beret) and Applied AI Engineer at USSOCOM. Builds decision intelligence systems that fuse visual and multi-domain data for the agentic age.

## Key facts
- Current role: Chief Technology Officer, Larx (https://larx.io) — intelligence / decision intelligence platform
- Prior: Applied AI Engineer, USSOCOM Intelligence Data Science Team (2021–2025)
- Military: US Army Special Forces (Green Beret), 2007–2023; Ranger, Jumpmaster, Combat Diver; combat valor awards
- Focus areas: agentic systems, visual AI, multi-source intelligence fusion, operational decision support
